result.topic_en: This page is a review summary of Euler's calculus of variations. It explains that the variation δy is an infinitely small increment added to y, and that variations δW of any differential or integral formula follow special rules. It adds that the method applies to all maximum and minimum problems and gives fuller solutions than the earlier geometric method.
